title: 教玩具行业与产品全景

intro.visual: 幼儿园俯瞰图 + 产品线分类
intro.background: 教玩具行业（Teaching Toy & Playground Equipment）是一个和文具完全不同的赛道。它不是卖标准SKU，而是卖项目、卖方案、卖整园设计。浙江温州永嘉桥下镇被称为中国教玩具之都，聚集了上千家工厂，产品出口全球100多个国家。一个完整的幼儿园项目通常包含：班级教室家具（桌椅、午睡床、玩具柜）、功能教室（阅读室、美工室、建构室）、户外大型游乐设备（滑梯、攀爬架）、户外功能区（沙池、水池、种植区）。
intro.desc: 认识教玩具三大产品线，掌握行业核心术语，理解项目制外贸和标准品外贸的区别。
tasks: 了解教玩具行业的三大产品线
区分班级家具、功能教室、户外设备
认识主要客户类型和市场
掌握行业基础英语词汇
outcomes: 能用英语介绍公司产品线
能听懂客户询盘中的产品术语
能区分项目制和标准品外贸
能识别自己在产业链中的位置

oneLiner.en: Teaching toys are not products on a shelf — they are whole-playground projects that start with a design and end with a happy kindergarten.
oneLiner.cn: 教玩具不是货架上的产品——它是从设计开始、到整个幼儿园落地的项目。

vocab.ex: We supply a full range of teaching toys for kindergartens and preschools.
vocab.exCn: 我们为幼儿园和托育中心供应全系列教玩具。

vocab.ex: Our outdoor playground equipment includes slides, climbing frames and swings.
vocab.exCn: 我们的户外游乐设备包括滑梯、攀爬架和秋千。

vocab.ex: Solid wood kindergarten furniture is our core product line.
vocab.exCn: 实木幼儿园家具是我们的核心产品线。

vocab.ex: Our target customers are preschools and daycare centers across Europe.
vocab.exCn: 我们的目标客户是欧洲各地的托育中心。

vocab.ex: We just completed a full-kindergarten project in Dubai.
vocab.exCn: 我们刚完成了一个迪拜的整园项目。

vocab.ex: Our factory is located in Qiaoxia, Yongjia, the hub of China teaching toy industry.
vocab.exCn: 我们工厂在永嘉桥下——中国教玩具之都。

vocab.ex: We provide both OEM and ODM services for overseas distributors.
vocab.cn: 贴牌生产 / 原创设计
vocab.exCn: 我们为海外经销商提供OEM和ODM服务。

vocab.ex: We also produce indoor soft play areas for toddlers.
vocab.exCn: 我们也生产幼儿室内软体游乐区。

mistakes.right: We specialize in kindergarten furniture and outdoor playground equipment — we are not a general toy trader.
mistakes.cn: 错误：把自己说成普通玩具/文具贸易商。教玩具是B2B项目制，客户是园所和工程商，不是C端玩具买家。

mistakes.wrong: Can I send you a catalog of our products?
mistakes.right: Could you share your floor plan or kindergarten size? We can propose a customized layout and quotation.
mistakes.cn: 错误：一上来就发产品目录。教玩具客户需要的是方案，不是目录。先问场地面积、班级数、预算。

basic.en: We are a manufacturer of kindergarten furniture and playground equipment.
basic.cn: 我们是幼儿园家具和游乐设备的生产厂家。

basic.en: Our factory is located in Qiaoxia, Yongjia, Wenzhou.
basic.cn: 我们工厂在温州永嘉桥下。

basic.en: We have three main product lines.
We can supply both indoor furniture and outdoor equipment.
basic.cn: 我们可以供应室内家具和户外设备。

basic.en: We have exported to more than 50 countries.
Could you tell me the size of your project?
basic.cn: 您能告诉我项目的规模吗？

advanced.en: Unlike standard stationery suppliers, we specialize in turnkey kindergarten projects — from space planning and 3D design to production, shipping and on-site installation guidance.
advanced.cn: 和标准文具供应商不同，我们专注于整园项目交钥匙工程——从空间规划、3D设计到生产、运输、现场安装指导。
advanced.from: We can supply both indoor furniture and outdoor equipment.

advanced.en: Our product portfolio covers four categories: classroom furniture, functional learning rooms, outdoor playground structures, and themed outdoor zones — all manufactured in our own 20,000 sqm facility.
advanced.cn: 我们的产品组合涵盖四大类：班级家具、功能学习教室、户外游乐结构、主题户外区——全部在我们自己的2万平米工厂生产。
advanced.from: We have three main product lines.

dialogues.title: 场景：新客户第一次询盘

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Hi, I found your company online. Can you tell me what you do exactly?
lines.cn: 你好，我在网上找到你们公司。能告诉我你们具体做什么吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Of course. We are a manufacturer based in Qiaoxia, Wenzhou — the teaching toy capital of China. We specialize in kindergarten furniture, functional learning rooms, and outdoor playground equipment.
lines.cn: 当然。我们是温州永嘉桥下的厂家——中国教玩具之都。我们专注于幼儿园家具、功能学习教室和户外游乐设备。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Interesting. We are planning a new kindergarten in Riyadh. Do you handle whole projects?
lines.cn: 有意思。我们在利雅得规划一个新幼儿园。你们做整园项目吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Absolutely. We provide turnkey solutions — from 3D design and space planning to production, shipping and installation guidance. Could you share the site area, number of classrooms, and your budget range?
lines.cn: 当然。我们提供交钥匙方案——从3D设计、空间规划到生产、运输、安装指导。您能分享一下场地面积、班级数和预算范围吗？

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: It is about 3,000 square meters, 12 classrooms. Budget is around 150,000 US dollars.
lines.cn: 大约3000平米，12个班。预算大约15万美金。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Perfect. Let me send you our project portfolio and we can prepare a preliminary layout proposal within three working days.
lines.cn: 太好了。我先把项目案例发给您，我们可以在3个工作日内准备初步布局方案。

culture.title: B2B项目制外贸的思维转变
culture.content: 从教文具标准品转到教玩具项目制，最大的思维转变是：客户买的不是产品，而是方案。1. 先问需求，再发产品：不要一上来就发产品目录。教玩具客户需要的是我的幼儿园3000平米，怎么规划。2. 项目周期长：一个整园项目从初次询盘到签约可能3-6个月，要跟进多次。3. 客单价高：一个项目10-50万美金。4. 决策链复杂：园长、投资人、设计师、工程商、教育局，要搞清楚谁拍板。5. 需要设计能力：会做3D效果图、CAD布局是核心竞争力。桥下镇的优势是产业链完整：木材厂、注塑厂、五金厂、海绵厂都在周边，一个项目可以快速集成。

aiPractice.situation: 你是温尚教玩具的外贸新人Quinn。一个德国幼教集团的采购经理Thomas通过LinkedIn联系你，想了解你们公司。
aiPractice.role: Thomas Weber，德国KitaGroup采购经理，专业且直接。

rounds.ai: Hi Quinn, I came across your company on LinkedIn. Can you briefly introduce what you do?
rounds.cn: Quinn你好，我在LinkedIn上看到你们公司。能简单介绍一下你们做什么吗？
rounds.hint: 介绍公司位置（桥下）、三大产品线、整园项目经验。

rounds.ai: We are currently planning two new kindergartens near Munich. Do you handle complete projects or just individual products?
rounds.cn: 我们正在慕尼黑附近规划两个新幼儿园。你们做完整项目还是只做单品？
rounds.hint: 强调turnkey交钥匙能力，从设计到安装。

rounds.ai: That sounds promising. What information do you need from us to prepare a proposal?
rounds.cn: 听起来不错。你们需要我们提供什么信息来准备方案？
rounds.hint: 问三个关键问题：场地面积、班级数/学位数、预算范围。

rounds.ai: Each kindergarten will be about 2,500 square meters with 10 classrooms. What is your typical lead time for such a project?
rounds.cn: 每个幼儿园大约2500平米，10个班。这类项目你们典型交期是多久？

rounds.ai: Great. Please send me your company profile and some reference projects in Europe.
rounds.cn: 好的。请发给我你们的公司介绍和欧洲的参考项目。
rounds.hint: 确认会发送，并约定下一步沟通时间。
